title: A set can be saved that was never done, when the phone ticks the set while the watch asks how hard it was
what: After Done on the watch, the 'How hard was it?' question waits up to 4 seconds before sending. The watch only reads which set to send at the end of that wait. If the same set is ticked on the phone in those seconds (the member or a trainer taps it there too), the phone moves on to the next set, and the watch then sends that NEXT set, with its suggested numbers and the effort picked, as done. The phone saves it, so the workout gains a set nobody did.
expected: The watch sends the set that was on screen when Done was tapped; if that set is already saved, nothing more is saved.
who: members who use the watch with Track effort on
how_often: rarely: only when the same set is ticked on the phone within 4 seconds
fix_line: Remember the set and its numbers at Done and send exactly those after the effort question

title: For a member who uses pounds, a set logged on the watch saves a slightly different weight than the same set ticked on the phone
what: The phone sends the weight to the watch rounded to one decimal in pounds, and the watch always sends that rounded number back, even when the member did not change it. The phone turns it back into kilos, so 22.5 kg comes back as 22.498 kg. Ticking the same untouched set on the phone keeps 22.5 kg. The difference is tiny on screen but the stored weight drifts away from the plan and can show as an odd number in kilos.
expected: An unchanged weight logged on the watch is saved exactly as the phone would save it.
how_often: every set logged on the watch in pounds
fix_line: Send no weight back when the member did not change it, or send the exact kilos the phone gave

title: The watch lets Done go on a set with no weight, then says 'Not saved' with a phone-off picture
what: On a weight-and-reps set with an empty weight (for example the first time a member does an exercise, with no last time and no target), the watch's Done is live. The phone refuses a weight-and-reps set with no weight, so nothing is saved. The watch starts the rest, waits 10 seconds, and then shows 'Not saved' with a crossed-out phone, as if the phone were out of reach. The reps the member set on the watch are lost and the real reason (add a weight) is never said on the watch.
expected: The watch asks for a weight before Done works on such a set, or says plainly that a weight is needed.
how_often: whenever a set has no weight yet, often on a new exercise
fix_line: Tell the watch whether a weight is required and keep Done off until there is one

title: The watch's effort choices leave out 9.5, which the phone offers
what: On the phone a member can rate a set 6 to 10 in half steps, including 9.5 ('Maybe 1 more rep'), with colours and a line saying what each number means. The watch offers eight numbers with no 9.5, and no colours or meanings. A member who rates 9.5 on the phone cannot pick the same on the watch.
expected: The same effort choices on watch and phone.
who: members who rate effort on the watch
how_often: every set rated on the watch
fix_line: Add 9.5 to the watch's effort choices, or state on purpose why it is left out

items.reason: the watch shows no dates; every rest time is an epoch end time compared with the clock, so no time zone enters
the watch has no import or undo-import
the watch keeps only short-lived screen state; every saved key has a safe default when an older version left it out, and the phone owns the workout data
the watch app has no AI feature and no network calls besides the phone link
no AI answers on the watch
the watch sends nothing to an AI company; it talks only to the paired phone
traced in code: watch Done, +15, -15 and Skip to the phone's handlers and the saved set, since the watch cannot run in the cloud
